about: NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY descriptors for the PS2 crow (em23, Phase 2 A3, PS2_CROW; tools/ps2_cast.py regcast of the presets crow-folded / crow-spread) plus the r100 dog (dog-01, the PS2_ANIMALS flat package's descriptor), so r100 keeps one room package. Render only: the GC skeleton, motions, AI and em23SetWing (folded BIN 6 / spread BIN 7) are unchanged; the PS2 mesh replaces the GC source body and wings on the owner path. User decision 2026-10-11: the solid PS2 wing is accepted (the GC folded wing's I4 mask pass is dropped), and the GX-only bump and alternate specular (body material flag 0x80, specularSetup2) are dropped by source_drops, as the DC source path never draws them.
lighting: dog-01: flat (as the PS2_ANIMALS package); crow: the source GX lighting record and source cull (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_SOURCE_LIGHT / RE4DC_NMR_SOURCE_CULL bit 8), as the source path draws it today
